tumble.description: After every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear. Remaining symbols fall and empty positions are replaced from above. Tumble continues until no new win appears.

ante_bet.description: Chance to win free spins naturally is doubled. More SCATTER symbols are present. BUY FREE SPINS is disabled when this mode is active.

buy_free_spins.description: FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.

rules_pages.title: GAME RULES
points: Symbols pay anywhere on the screen.
The total number of the same symbol on screen at spin end determines the win.
SCATTER symbol is present on all reels and pays on any position.
All values are shown as actual wins in coins.

rules_pages.title: TUMBLE FEATURE
points: After every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols disappear.
Remaining symbols fall to the bottom and empty positions are replaced from above.
Tumbling continues until no more winning combinations appear.
Multiplier symbols are present on all reels and can hit during spins and tumbles.
When a multiplier symbol hits, it takes a random value from 2x to 1000x.
At sequence end, multiplier values are added and total sequence win is multiplied by the final value.

rules_pages.title: FREE SPINS RULES
points: FREE SPINS feature is awarded when 4 or more SCATTER symbols hit anywhere.
The round starts with 15 free spins.
In FREE SPINS, when a multiplier symbol hits and spin results in a win, value is added to total multiplier.
For the full duration of FREE SPINS, new multiplier hits that result in a win keep adding to total multiplier value.
Whenever 3 or more SCATTER symbols hit during FREE SPINS, 5 additional free spins are awarded.
Special reels are in play during FREE SPINS.

rules_pages.title: GAME RULES
points: Volatility: High.
High volatility pays less often on average, but chance for big short-term wins is higher.
Symbols pay anywhere.
All wins are multiplied by base bet.
When winning with multiple symbols, all wins are added to total win.
The theoretical RTP of this game is 96.50%.
RTP using ANTE BET is 96.50%.
RTP using BUY FREE SPINS is 96.49%.
MINIMUM BET: $0.20.
MAXIMUM BET: $125.00.
Malfunction voids all pays and plays.

rules_pages.title: HOW TO PLAY
points: Use plus/minus controls to change bet value and open bet menu.
Press SPIN button to play.
Settings menu controls gameplay settings.
Spin speed cycles through normal, quick spin and turbo spin.
Sound and music can be toggled on/off.
Information page opens in-game rules pages.
Autoplay button opens automatic play menu and can be pressed again to stop.

rules_pages.title: SETTINGS MENU
points: Intro screen toggle.
Ambient music toggle.
Sound FX toggle.
Game history page access.
Information screen page navigation and close controls.
Bet menu shows bet multiplier and total bet in coins/cash.
Maximum win amount is limited to 15000x bet; if reached, round ends and remaining features are forfeited.

rules_pages.title: AUTOPLAY
points: Click button showing number of possible auto-spins to start Autoplay.
Skip Screens option auto-skips feature introduction and end screens after a short period.
